statistical_content_note: no estimand, weight, population, contrast, bootstrap parameter or ceiling changes. A5 adds an output-validity rule that decides which observations are admissible, and the missingness reporting that accompanies it.

the_rule.1_definition: a response is capped_incomplete when it exhausts max_new_tokens without emitting an EOS / valid terminal completion
the_rule.2_invalid_for_analysis: capped_incomplete is invalid even when the frozen parser finds a numeric score
the_rule.4_no_human_recovery: capped_incomplete never enters human score recovery: an explicitly final score cannot be inferred from an incomplete generation
the_rule.5_recovery_unchanged: uncapped parser failures follow the frozen recovery process
the_rule.6_paired_complete_case: frozen rule retained: a task contributes to a contrast only when both relevant condition scores are valid
the_rule.7_reporting: missingness and retained-pair counts by scorer x dataset x condition, reported ALONGSIDE the frozen R5 differential-attrition checks, not instead of them

completeness_is_decided_by_terminator_pr.why_not_length: trim_to_first_eos is inclusive, so a response whose last token is its terminator has equal raw and trimmed lengths and would be misread as unterminated

measured_basis.source: 36-call A4 validation at 2048 continuing the same 36 generations from the 512-ceiling diagnostic; condition-blind, held-out tasks
measured_basis.interpretation: a capped response can be silently and badly wrong while looking well-formed to a strict parser; the parser did nothing wrong, the text it was given was not a finished answer

residual_at_2048.mechanism: loops on arithmetic re-derivation, never concludes

unchanged_by_A5: the frozen 578-task manifest and its hash
the six conditions and their exact added_context wording
the scoring prompt renderer and its wording
the frozen recovery module (score_recovery.py) -- NOT modified
the four-scorer panel and every pinned revision
call IDs and the total of 13,872 scoring calls
the primary 8-cell estimand at 1/8 and the secondary 12-cell estimand at 1/12
the bootstrap plan (10,000 replicates, seed 20260818, task-clustered, dataset-stratified, shared draws)
the 7 diagnostic contrasts and the robustness suite R1-R5
S1_three_scorer_sensitivity (6 cells at 1/6, 9 cells at 1/9, non-confirmatory)
the retry / technical-failure policy and the no-reserve-substitution rule

wired_into: scripts/run_final_scoring.py (stamps the verdict on every record)
implementation.additive: parse_ok and parsed_score keep their original meaning; the verdict is stored once and read by resume, recovery, adjudication and analysis so they cannot disagree

explicit_non_claims: NOT claimed that the residual capped_incomplete rate is ignorable or that its missingness is uninformative
NOT claimed that excluding these observations is unbiased with respect to the estimand; it removes a known-wrong measurement and reports the attrition
NOT claimed that the four corrected scores generalise in magnitude or direction (n=4, one task, no condition contrast computed)
NOT claimed that anything follows about the conditions; the four responses were examined only as parsing artefacts
